1. PICNIC PLAN — We are going to meet at ten by the park gate. Bring a litre of water and your lunch.

2. Hi Jo, it may rain this afternoon. Let’s have lunch inside the visitor centre instead of on the grass. Ben

3. CAMPING AREA — Please put wet coats outside your tent. Keep the sleeping area dry.

4. WEATHER UPDATE — Strong wind is possible tonight. The boat tour is cancelled, but the walking tour will go ahead.

5. PARK CAFE — We are going to open at eleven on Friday, one hour later than usual.

6. RENT A BICYCLE — Return it before six in the evening. Do not leave it at the park gate overnight.
